compatibility.legacy_catalog_fields: do not rename or remove as part of this contract

slug.purpose: stable URL-safe instrument identifier; must not replace id

prompt_markers.purpose: phrases that may provide contextual evidence for an instrument

consumers.purpose: registered runtime components that consume this instrument

inputs.purpose: declared input concepts or payload fields

outputs.purpose: declared output concepts or payload fields

status.purpose: descriptive lifecycle metadata; activation.enabled remains authoritative

identity_resolution.activation_gate: activation.enabled must be true for functional resolution
identity_resolution.matching_policy: exact normalized canonical title or exact registered alias with word boundaries
identity_resolution.ambiguous_match: fail closed; do not activate a candidate
identity_resolution.partial_tokens: never sufficient to establish instrument identity

migration_rules: Do not change schema_version 2 or template_id in the existing registry.
Add optional metadata only when supported by repository evidence; do not infer consumers or inputs from filenames alone.
Keep aliases and prompt_markers distinct: aliases are accepted identity names; prompt_markers are contextual evidence and cannot independently override ambiguity.
Do not replace the current resolver, contextual router, specialized executor, catalog generator, or execution map wholesale.
Validate each incremental change against existing registry, resolver, router, execution-map, and traceability tests.
